ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, Yamamoto schedule searches, and current Japanese-jazz sources produced no new unrecorded Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. This batch adds one freshly announced Greater Tokyo/Kanto event: Ryo Takaiwa's first Billboard Live tour stop in Yokohama, built around a new Ryo Takaiwa Big Band. Priority A is deliberate: the cross-genre jazz-vocal/big-band concept clears RADAR admission, but the full big-band personnel remain unannounced and the same tour continues in Osaka, so the current evidence supports 'worth knowing/attending if convenient' rather than active-priority or scarcity language. lineup: New Ryo Takaiwa Big Band — additional personnel TBA
events.factual_description: Billboard Live Yokohama presents Ryo Takaiwa on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, with stages at 4:00 PM and 7:00 PM. The engagement is part of Takaiwa's first Billboard Live tour and is announced as a performance with a new Ryo Takaiwa Big Band; the venue currently names Takaiwa on vocals and leaves the additional personnel to be announced. Billboard describes Takaiwa's path from jazz vocalist at age 18 through SANABAGUN., THE THROTTLE, electronic project INF and his jazz album TAKAIWA, and frames the Yokohama date as a large-scale club presentation of his current cross-genre work. The tour continues at Billboard Live Osaka on November 13, 2026.

enrichment.note: The exact Billboard Live Yokohama event page, the official eplus tour presale destination, and exact Apple Music album pages for TAKAIWA and 10 are verified. The full new big-band personnel are explicitly not yet announced; no names beyond Ryo Takaiwa were inferred.

Repository searches for Ryo Takaiwa, 高岩遼, Billboard Live Yokohama and the proposed stable event ID found no existing canonical or inbox record before publication. Additional big-band personnel were not inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Takaiwa is interesting precisely because he refuses to keep jazz vocals, hip-hop, rock, electronic music and showmanship in separate boxes. The Yokohama date returns that vocabulary to a large-ensemble setting: his first solo album was built with a full big band, and this first Billboard Live tour is explicitly introducing a new Ryo Takaiwa Big Band. That makes the arranging scale and groove part of the reason to listen, not just decoration behind a singer. The current listing stops short of naming the band, so the musical promise is real but the event should not be oversold before the personnel are known.
en.trip_verdict: Worth keeping on the Kanto board if November 3 is open, especially for a night centered on Japanese jazz vocals, big-band arranging and genre collision. I would attend if it fits cleanly, while keeping a rarer master, one-off lineup or premiere ahead of it until the full band is announced.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante de Takaiwa es precisamente que no separa jazz vocal, hip-hop, rock, electrónica y espectáculo en compartimentos distintos. La fecha de Yokohama devuelve ese vocabulario a una escala grande: su primer disco solista ya nació con una big band completa y esta primera gira de Billboard Live presenta explícitamente una nueva Ryo Takaiwa Big Band. Eso hace que los arreglos y el groove sean parte del motivo para escuchar, no simple decoración detrás de un cantante. La página actual todavía no publica quién integra la banda, así que la promesa musical es real pero no conviene venderla por encima de la evidencia disponible.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero de Kanto si el 3 de noviembre está libre, sobre todo para una noche de jazz vocal japonés, arreglos de big band y choque de géneros. Entraría si acomoda limpio en el calendario, pero mantendría por delante a un maestro más escaso, una alineación irrepetible o un estreno hasta conocer la formación completa.
